name: adv_naming_case_folded_member
source:
// Variable names are case-insensitive: PA.w must resolve to the same scalar as
// PA.W, and s2.p to s2.P. Display names come from the first-seen spelling.
COMPONENT Lift(in, out)
  PARAM v, eta
  out.mdot = in.mdot
  out.h    = in.h + v * (out.P - in.P) / eta
  W        = in.mdot * (out.h - in.h)
END
COMPONENT FluidBoundary(out)
  PARAM P, h, mdot
  out.P    = P
  out.h    = h
  out.mdot = mdot
END
FluidBoundary SRC(s1, P = 100000, h = 112000, mdot = 1.0)
Lift          PA(s1, s2, v = 0.001, eta = 0.7)
Sink          SK(s2)
s2.P = 250000
lower_w = PA.w
upper_w = PA.W
lower_p = s2.p
